title: the Hacker News front page, twelve rows

style.reason: the page has no doctype, so the landside render is quirks mode: tables refuse the body font there (16px Times) while the standards-mode mirror inherits 13px Verdana into every cell; the html and head rows of the same failure are P-119's root-inheritance leak

geometry.reason: the quirks-vs-standards font difference reflows every table row; the landside page measures 173px taller

notes: captured from the live site through the pipeline (capture 20260820-072612), imported with bundle import -fetch-assets, trimmed to twelve rows. The markup is 90s-style table soup with width="0" spacer images and nbsp-joined text — the page whose capture proved P-124. Story links point at their live URLs and are never followed: corpus pages are measured, not browsed
